## 2. Native BK video streaming (Android)

### Entry activities

| Class | Path | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `GlassesLiveActivity` | `.../feature-glasses/.../GlassesLiveActivity.kt` | Full BK live page (AP → DevSocketMgr → H264 render + phone camera fallback) |
| `GlassesLivePreviewActivity` | `.../feature-glasses/.../GlassesLivePreviewActivity.kt` | Lightweight BK preview dialog |
| `GlassesLive2Activity` | `.../GlassesLive2Activity.kt` | **AKW only** — RTSP via `EasyPlayerClient`, not BK |

### Flow (BK glasses)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant UI as GlassesLiveActivity
  participant AP as DevApMgr
  participant BLE as BLE switchWifiUdp
  participant DS as DevSocketMgr
  participant SDK as BKSmartCameraDelegate
  participant SV as H264SurfaceView

  UI->>AP: DevApMgr.start(2) + startPreview()
  AP->>BLE: open hotspot via BLE event
  AP->>UI: onConnectSuccess()
  UI->>DS: start(mac)
  DS->>BLE: switchWifiUdp(true)
  DS->>SDK: connect(sn) TCP STATION mode
  SDK-->>DS: onConnected(ip) → openVideo()
  SDK-->>DS: onReceiveFrameUnpackedData(H264 bytes)
  DS-->>UI: STATE_FRAME + ByteArray
  UI->>SV: surfaceView.postFrame(bytes)
```

### `DevSocketMgr.kt`

Path: `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/WearfitPro-feat-zsc-wakeok_theme_variant/commponent/src/main/java/com/wakeup/commponent/module/device/work/devNet/DevSocketMgr.kt`

**Purpose:** Singleton manager for 博通 (BK) camera over Wi-Fi.

| Method | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `start(mac)` | Wi-Fi lock → BLE `switchWifiUdp(true)` → `connect(sn)` with 10s timeout |
| `stop()` | `disconnect()` + `closeVideoPreview()` + notify disconnect |
| `openVideo()` | H264 1280×720, DVP camera, rotate 0, TCP → `openVideoPreview()` |
| `closeVideo()` | `closeVideoPreview()` |
| `registerVideoCallback(tag, callback)` | Multicast frame/state callbacks |
| `getCurrentImg(callback)` | Saves next `CameraResult.bitmap` to PNG |
| `getDeviceIp(mac)` / `getDeviceIpNotCache(mac)` | `bkSmartCameraDelegate.getIp(sn)` |

**Callback states:** `STATE_CONNECTED(1)`, `STATE_FRAME(2)`, `STATE_DISCONNECT(-1)`, `STATE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT(-2)`, `STATE_FRAME_TIMEOUT(-3)` (10s no frame).

**Connect options:** `WifiMode.STATION`, `Transmission.TCP`, scan timeout 10s.

### `BKSmartCameraDelegate` (Android SDK surface)

Used via lazy singleton + these calls:

- `setConnectOptions(BkSmartCameraConnectOptions)` → `connect(sn)` / `disconnect()`
- `setVideoOptions(BkSmartCameraVideoOptions)` → `openVideoPreview()` / `closeVideoPreview()`
- `getIp(sn, callback)`

**Video callbacks (`OnVideoCallback`):**

- `onVideoPreviewState(videoPreviewOn: Boolean)`
- `onError(code: Int)`
- `onReceiveFrame(result: CameraResult)` — decoded bitmap (used for snapshot)
- `onReceiveFrameUnpackedData(frameData: ByteArray, cameraFormat: CameraFormat)` — **primary preview path**
- `onReceiveFrameUnpackedBadData(...)`

### Frame format & rendering

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Format | **H.264** (`CameraFormat.H264`), 1280×720 |
| Transport | Proprietary BK SDK over TCP (not RTSP) |
| View type | Custom **`H264SurfaceView`** extends **`SurfaceView`** (not TextureView) |
| Decoder | Android **`MediaCodec`** hardware H.264 → Surface |
| Feed API | `postFrame(ByteArray)` queues NAL units into MediaCodec |

Path: `.../feature-glasses/.../view/H264SurfaceView.kt`

Phone-camera fallback in `GlassesLiveActivity` uses CameraX **`PreviewView`** (separate from glasses stream).

### iOS BK delegate (for comparison)

Path: `.../phancy-sdk/.../WKBKSmartApp.swift`

`WKBKSmartCameraDelegate` exposes:

- Raw/unpacked video: `didReciveFrameRawData`, `didReceiveFrameUnpackedUseData`, `didReceiveFrameRawBuffer(CVPixelBuffer?)`, `didReceiveVideoImage(UIImage)`
- Audio variants
- Lifecycle: `cameraControlDidOpenCamera`, `cameraControlDidClosedCamera`, display open/close

iOS preview (`GlassesLivePreviewViewController`) uses `WKSmartGlassesVideoView` and receives **`UIImage`** frames from `WKSmartGlassesAIAssistant`.

## 3. `GlassesP2pVisualStream` (Flutter)

Full file: `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/common/common_glasses_p2p/lib/src/impl/glasses_p2p_visual_stream.dart`

**Structure:**

```dart
class GlassesP2pVisualStream implements VisualStream {
  // deps: GlassesP2pSession
  // inner: VisualStream? _inner  (always FijkVisualStream when connected)
  // RTSP: rtsp://{ip}:554/vs0?aspect_ratio=16_9&type=0
}
```

**Connect flow:**

1. Fast path: if `session.cachedHost` exists, probe RTSP (3s timeout)
2. Full path: `session.openPreview()` → BLE Wi-Fi wake → P2P/AP connect → get IP
3. `_connectRtsp(ip)` → `FijkVisualStream().connect(VisualStreamConfig.url(...))`

**Disconnect:**

- `disconnect()` — tears down RTSP only, keeps Wi-Fi group for fast reconnect
- `fullDisconnect()` — also `session.scheduleClose(type: 2)` to stop glasses video

**Preview:** delegates to `_inner.buildPreview()` → `FijkView`; placeholder `ColoredBox` when disconnected.

**Important:** This is the **AKW RTSP path**. BK glasses do **not** expose RTSP; they need `DevSocketMgr` + H264 frame pipeline instead. Docs explicitly mark BK video as 待补 (`native_app/inventory/04-flutter-target-map.md`).

**Wi-Fi routing already partially ready:**

- `glassesWifiApModeProvider` — default `Platform.isIOS` (AP); BK Android needs App override to `true`
- `GlassesP2pSession` supports AP + P2P for Wi-Fi join, but video layer ignores vendor

## 4. `VisualStream` interface (core)

Path: `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_visual_stream/lib/src/service/visual_stream.dart`

```dart
abstract class VisualStream {
  Future<void> connect(VisualStreamConfig config);
  Future<void> disconnect();
  Stream<VisualStreamEvent> get events;
  Widget buildPreview();
  Future<Uint8List> captureFrame();
}
```

**Related types:**

- `VisualStreamConfig` — `mock | url | platform | camera` + optional URI/headers/timeout
- `VisualStreamEvent` — `idle | connecting | previewing | buffering | disconnected | error`
- `PlatformVisualStream` — **stub only**, throws `VISUAL_STREAM_PLATFORM_UNIMPLEMENTED`

**Existing implementations:**

| Class | Backend | Preview widget |
|---|---|---|
| `FijkVisualStream` | RTSP/HLS via fijkplayer | `FijkView` |
| `MediaKitVisualStream` | URL via media_kit | `Video(...)` |
| `CameraVisualStream` | phone camera | `CameraPreview` |
| `MockVisualStream` | fake | placeholder |
| `PlatformVisualStream` | unimplemented | empty |

Spec: `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/specs/capabilities/visual_stream.md` — vendor/BK should implement `VisualStream`, not leak into Features.

## 5. Existing Android platform-view plugins (besides fijkplayer)

**No first-party Flutter plugin in `packages/` registers a PlatformView.**  
`common_glasses_p2p` is MethodChannel-only (Wi-Fi connect).

**Third-party deps that render via platform views** (used by `core_visual_stream`):

| Package | Widget | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `fijkplayer_max` | `FijkView` | Glasses RTSP (AKW) |
| `camera` | `CameraPreview` | Phone fallback |
| `media_kit_video` | `Video` | Generic URL preview |

`PlatformVisualStream` is the intended extension point for BK/native SDK preview — currently empty.

---

## Estimated scope to implement BK video in Flutter

### What already exists (reuse)

- BLE Wi-Fi lifecycle: `GlassesP2pSession` + `GlassesP2pChannel` (AP mode for BK)
- `VisualStream` contract + Feature wiring (`glasses_app` → `GlassesP2pVisualStream`)
- Native reference implementation: `DevSocketMgr` + `H264SurfaceView` + `DevApMgr`
- SDK binaries in reference tree (not yet vendored into Flutter)

### What must be built

| Work item | Effort | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Vendor SDK into Flutter plugin | Medium | Copy/link `iot_bk_sdk.aar`; iOS Pod from private spec (`wkpodspec.git`) |
| New plugin e.g. `core_vendor_bk` or extend `common_glasses_p2p` | Medium | Port `DevSocketMgr` API surface |
| **PlatformView** for H264 preview | Medium–High | Android: port `H264SurfaceView`; iOS: bridge `BKSmartCameraKit` → UIView/Texture |
| New `BkVisualStream implements VisualStream` | Medium | Connect: AP + BLE UDP + SDK connect + openVideo; no RTSP |
| Vendor routing | Small–Medium | Detect BK vs AKW (`glassesWifiApModeProvider`, chipType/netType); swap `GlassesP2pVisualStream` inner impl |
| `captureFrame()` | Medium | Android: snapshot from SDK bitmap or grab decoded frame; iOS: UIImage → bytes |
| App overrides | Small | BK Android: `glassesWifiApModeProvider → true` |
| Hardware QA | High | Frame timeout, AP join UX, concurrent stream conflicts (native stops other previews first) |

### Rough sizing

- **Android-only MVP** (PlatformView + AAR + AP path): ~1–2 weeks with hardware
- **iOS + Android** (Pod access + dual PlatformView): ~2–4 weeks
- **Risk:** private Pod/AAR distribution, 16KB page size (SDK branch name suggests this was addressed in May 2026 merge), no Java runtime here to fully decompile delegate API (usage in `DevSocketMgr` is authoritative)

### Recommended architecture (aligned with existing spec)

```
Feature (object recognition)
  └─ visualStreamProvider
       ├─ AKW → GlassesP2pVisualStream → FijkVisualStream (RTSP)     [exists]
       └─ BK  → BkGlassesVisualStream → PlatformView + native SDK     [new]
```

Key decision: BK cannot reuse `FijkVisualStream` — frames are raw H.264 over BK proprietary TCP, not `rtsp://...:554/vs0`.
